$description: The two-year programme as a timeline for the home page's two-years section. Each step names the facts it states. The recurring rhythm is shown beside the steps.

steps.title: Foundation period
steps.detail: A short start before Class 11, so the first weeks are not a shock.

steps.title: The base in all three subjects
steps.detail: A test after every chapter and a longer test every 4th week. A full JEE Main mock every month.

steps.title: JEE Advanced joins the plan
steps.detail: A JEE Advanced mock every quarter, on top of the monthly JEE Main mock.

steps.title: JEE Main
steps.detail: Two sessions. {{fact:exam.jee-main#questions}} questions in {{fact:exam.jee-main#hours}} hours, all compulsory.

steps.title: JEE Advanced
steps.detail: For those who qualify: {{fact:exam.jee-advanced#papers}} papers of {{fact:exam.jee-advanced#hoursEach}} hours each, on one day.

rhythm.what: A test on the online portal, topic-wise and full syllabus in turn
A full JEE Main mock: {{fact:exam.jee-main#questions}} questions, {{fact:exam.jee-main#hours}} hours
Doubts on the forum, or at a doubt session
